mainEntity.name: How long does a custom swimming pool typically last?

acceptedAnswer.text: With proper construction and ongoing maintenance, a custom swimming pool can last for many decades. The structural shell of a gunite pool, for example, can endure for 50 years or more. Components like pumps, filters, and heaters typically have a lifespan of 7-15 years and can be replaced as needed. Finishes such as plaster usually last 5-15 years before needing resurfacing, while aggregate finishes can last significantly longer. Regular cleaning, balanced water chemistry, and timely repairs are crucial for maximizing the pool's lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: A custom pool can last many decades with proper construction and maintenance. The shell endures for 50+ years, while components like pumps and finishes have shorter, replaceable lifespans.
